name: @comchatx/cx-sponsored-ads-playbook
description: Traces why ad spend or sales moved, then judges each fix.
author: ComChatX

comchatx.name: Amazon Ads Playbook
comchatx.about: 查出广告花费和销量变化的原因，改后判断是否见效。

ads-review.zh: 分析广告表现，以及花费和销量变化的原因。
ads-review.en: How your ads perform, and why spend or sales moved.

ads-launch.zh: 判断新品能否投广告，并搭建首批广告活动。
ads-launch.en: Whether a new product can advertise, and its first campaigns.

ads-structure-and-targets.zh: 分析广告活动的结构和每种投放会匹配什么。
ads-structure-and-targets.en: How campaigns are built, and what each target matches.

ads-search-terms.zh: 找出值得单独投放和该否定的搜索词。
ads-search-terms.en: Search terms worth targeting, and ones to negate.

ads-bids-and-budgets.zh: 分析出价、版位和预算如何决定花费。
ads-bids-and-budgets.en: How bids, placements and budgets decide what you spend.

ads-seasons.zh: 安排大促前后的预算、出价和促销。
ads-seasons.en: Budgets, bids and deals around Amazon's sales events.

ads-economics.zh: 算出广告订单的利润和广告对总销量的贡献。
ads-economics.en: What an ad sale earns, and what ads add to total sales.

ads-change.zh: 查广告改动记录，判断一次改动是否见效。
ads-change.en: Amazon's change history, and whether a change worked.

ads-review.zh: 复盘最近几周的广告，并提出修改。

ads-launch.zh: 为新品开始投广告，从能否投放到首批广告活动。

ads-harvest.zh: 梳理搜索词，找出值得单独投放和该否定的词。

ads-season.zh: 为下一个亚马逊大促准备好广告。

ads-margin.zh: 算出广告订单能赚多少，以及盈亏平衡的 ACOS。

ads-brand.zh: 看看谁在你的品牌搜索词和商品页上投广告，守住要花多少钱。

ads-change-review.zh: 判断某一天的广告改动是否见效。
